ownerDescription: Cha is a specialty cafe & American bakery with all day easy eats. We roast coffee in-house and bake daily. We are located on Beach Road in Garapan, Saipan, USA at the entrance of Saipan's tourist district.

owner.name: John Lee
owner.bio: Born and raised in the CNMI, SCA-certified professional roaster.
owner.quoteLong: The standards we have are comparable to the best cafés in New York.

story.title: A hole-in-the-wall on Beach Road
story.body: Cha opens as a roughly 10-seat café. Its first product is fresh-brewed milk tea, credited with starting Saipan's café craze.

story.title: Five times the space, 50 seats
story.body: A move a few doors down. Rebranded Cha Café and Bakery, L.A.-inspired "urban boardwalk" style, a custom Italian espresso machine and a glass pastry case on black marble counters.

story.title: Cha Bistro opens upstairs
story.body: A second-floor dining room above the bakery, serving lunch and dinner by a local executive chef.

story.title: Mobil Middle Road
story.body: Cha's second location: a drive-thru at the Mobil service station on Middle Road, Garapan.
story.confirm: Opening year of the Middle Road drive-thru

story.title: Gold, Best Coffee
story.body: Best of the Marianas 2023 names Cha the island's best coffee.

story.title: Mobil Chalan Kiya
story.body: The second drive-thru opens, announced on October 5, 2026.
